entries.text: Version numbers were renumbered: 3.0.0, 4.0.0, 4.1.0 and 4.2.0 are now 2.3.0, 2.4.0, 2.5.0 and 2.6.0. Nothing about the app itself changed.
When a manager approves a work item, the history and chat now show only "approved". The extra "set state to Done" line and "updated your work item" card are gone.
Approval and rejection notices now reach everyone assigned to the work item, not only the person who asked for approval.
Typing @ in a work item now also lists people outside the department, greyed out and not selectable, so you can tell they exist.
The parent picker lists work items that already have sub-work items first.
Super Admins can change assignees on any work item, and a failed update now shows the server's reason.
